title: File:Female artisanal miner in Central Kalimantan panning for gold without using mercury.jpg
desc: A woman artisanal miner panning for gold in Central Kalimantan . Photograph taken in October 2018 during field documentation of a artisanal and small scale gold mining (ASGM) community in Tewang Pajangan, Kurun subdistrict, Gunung Mas Regency, Central Kalimantan Province, Indonesia.
